title: BPW-2026-0641
text:
[JOINT REPORT]
BPW-2026-0641
BOE + BCA
CD 8
EXECUTE AMENDMENT NO. 2 – WESTERN GAGE MEDIAN PARK PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE and FORWARD this report with transmittals to the Mayor requesting the following:
APPROVE Amendment No. 2 to the contract between the City of Los Angeles and the Los Angeles Neighborhood Initiative to increase the total budget authority from $420,465 to $494,969;
AUTHORIZE the President or two Commissioners of the Board to execute Amendment No. 2;
NOTIFY the Bureau of Engineering (BOE), Street Improvement Division, George Huang, at (213) 485-1159, when this Amendment is ready to be executed by the Board, whereupon four original copies of the Amendment will be delivered to the Executive Officer of the Board for signature; and
REQUEST the City Clerk to attest and certify the four original copies of Amendment No. 2 after execution. The City Clerk and the Board will each retain one original copy and two original copies are to be returned to the BOE, George Huang.
(W.O.: E1908872, C-145155)
summary: Board of Public Works approval of a second amendment to the Western Gage Median Park contract with the Los Angeles Neighborhood Initiative, raising the total budget authority from $420,465 to $494,969.
